ticketing.notes: Registration fees from the conference's Registration page, in ILS. Early rates ran until 25 Sept 2026; the regular rates from 26 Sept are the ones listed. Full conference or a single day (18, 19 or 20 Oct); ISRA members are those who paid 2025 and 2026 fees. The fee includes the welcome reception, all sessions, the exhibition, lunch and coffee breaks. Registration and payment through the conference secretariat, Ortra (radiology@ortra.com). The conference is for physicians, residents, medical students and health professions only.

venues.name: David's Harp Galilee Resort
venues.notes: The conference hotel, above the northwest shore of the Sea of Galilee (the conference site's Home and Accommodation pages name it). The programme runs in three halls, A, B and C, which it does not map onto the hotel's own halls: the hotel lists the Agam hall (475 theatre-style, divisible into Agam A and Agam B, 200 each), four meeting rooms of 15 to 110 and a 700-seat amphitheatre (davidsharphotels.com/galilee/events/), so no seat count is served for a programme hall. Registration, breaks, lunch and the evening social events are listed across all three halls.
